scope: Single real Kimi lifecycle case in existing probe
Structured native tool-history evidence, native identity, stop execution ownership, persisted abort and cleanup
Held local model response and failure cleanup; unchanged production runtime

findings.finding: Initial probe incorrectly required historyRecoveryInjected=false on normal native continuation
findings.resolution: Existing engine deliberately adds a bounded continuity copy. Prove restoration using the same native ID, structured historical tool_calls/results, no reset/recovery, and fresh Read after stop. Require real Kimi ACP metadata on both later turns.

independentValidation.evidenceStrength: Bounded user-text copy cannot manufacture historical tool_calls/role=tool results; native ID and new post-stop tool corroborate actual continuity
independentValidation.cleanupTiming: Observe held response close before finally destroys it; stop is requested only after a real held model request and matching active execution
independentValidation.testDiscipline: One required lifecycle case in existing file, no new production code, test file or generic framework
independentValidation.reviewerExecution: Static source/contract review; no concurrent tests

evidenceBoundary: Active prompt cancellation and native session continuation with real Kimi and local deterministic model. Does not prove long-running Bash descendant stop, direct capture of outbound resume RPC, real account service or other CLI.
